nonblocking_findings: A2-1 [Minor] review-a: harness/model-guide/preview.sh:30: The ancestor rule misses the path `/`. For `/`, the test `${DOCS_REAL#"$PREVIEW_REAL"/}` removes the prefix `//`, which never matches, so `--preview /` is allowed. The refused set is then not every ancestor of docs. No docs write results, but no test covers it. Fix: refuse when PREVIEW_REAL equals `/`.

A2-2 [Minor] review-a: measure/tracks/model_guide/plan.md:239: The evidence of task 1.9 is stale against HEAD. `preview-1.9.txt` was recorded at ef2d16f, before the round 2 edits to real-work.ts and preview.sh. I ran real-work.ts on the real export at HEAD into /tmp. It gave exit 0 and the same five values, so the claim still holds. The closeout gate must still run preview.sh on the final HEAD. The counts in tasks 1.4, 1.6, and 1.7 (6 and 7 passed) are true for their commits only. HEAD gives 11 and 39.

A2-3 [Nit] review-a: measure/tracks/model_guide/plan.md:228: Task 1.8 is marked [x] 3a477f5 before a new review passes. The Verify text allows this when each blocker has a fix commit, and A1 and A2 have 3a477f5. The file `check-1.8.json` does not exist. This round of reviews closes the gap if the gate passes.

A2-4 [Nit] review-a: harness/model-guide/publish.ts:115: The test `rel in baseDocs` reads the prototype chain of the parsed JSON object. A docs file named `constructor` or `toString` would not count as added. Use `Object.hasOwn`. A preview-base.json with invalid JSON throws a stack trace and exits 1. No file is written in that case.

A2-5 [Nit] review-a: harness/model-guide-tests/leak-guard.test.ts:44: The B3 guard test passed on the Red commit, so it has no failing-first proof. It is a guard on a clean tree. The needle build and the file walk read as correct. Judged acceptable.
